notes: Map Rotation now survives a relogin. With a rotation set, the bot would stop travelling after it logged back in and just sit there. It travels again straight away, and if it ever does refuse to travel it now says why every 60 seconds instead of going quiet. A trip that has to warp before it walks no longer gives up part way; the walk to a map exit was being abandoned whenever the journey needed a warp first. A bond buff placed above a toggle in your buff list now casts, so Fury Bond is no longer skipped on every tick when it sits above a toggle. Berserkers can put Wild Charge in the damage rotation and it will be cast, where before it was skipped every tick. While the bot walks a Saved Area route it no longer competes with its own route for the controls. Update as usual, the app reinstalls itself cleanly.
